nrmse_definition: Intensity RMS error divided by reference dynamic range; computed separately for each passband.
psf_relative_error_definition: L2 norm of predicted minus reproduced unit-flux PSFs divided by reproduced PSF L2 norm.
observation_relative_error_definition: L2 norm of all local reconstructed-object/PSF forward residuals divided by normalized apodized observation L2 norm.
provenance: Fixed extraction-quality tolerances, independent original repeat and fresh reruns; see test/validation.md. No physical truth available.
v2_definition: All local objects and physical KL wavefronts must jointly reproject every selected real frame within the unchanged observation-quality budget; mosaic must equal their declared merge and both translation/null gauges hold. No hidden solar image or PSF agreement. Hidden arrays used are only pupil and phase_basis derived from public theoretical KL calibration and stated aperture.
